WITH BIZ_BASE AS ( SELECT biz01_promo.* , biz90_limit.* , biz02_cnt.* , TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / (CASE WHEN biz01_provide_rcv_type = '2' THEN f_nvl(biz02_emp_count,1) ELSE f_nvl(biz02_count ,1) END)) AS biz01_average_price , TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / f_nvl(biz01_peple_count,1)) AS biz01_average_price2 , CASE WHEN biz01_settle_type = '1' THEN f_get_crdManagerId(biz01_card_id, biz01_provide_date) ELSE biz01_reg_emp_id END AS person_id FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN biz90_limit ON ( biz90_company_id = biz01_company_id AND biz90_provide_rcv_type = biz01_provide_rcv_type AND biz90_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(biz90_start_date) FROM biz90_limit WHERE biz90_company_id = biz01_company_id AND biz90_provide_rcv_type = biz01_provide_rcv_type AND biz90_start_date <= biz01_provide_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS biz02_count , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS biz02_emp_count , f_emp_kor_nm(MAX(biz02_emp_id)) AS biz02_emp_nm , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS biz02_target_count , MAX(CONCAT(biz02_target_company_nm,' ' ,biz02_target_emp_nm ,'('||biz02_target_org_nm||')')) AS biz02_target_nm FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id ) biz02_cnt ON TRUE WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_provide_rcv_type LIKE #{provideRcvType} AND biz01_provide_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,1,1) IN ('1','2') /* 10:판매(일반)/11:판매(경조)/20:운용(일반)/21:운용(경조)/50:관리(일반) */ ) SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY biz01_provide_date, biz01_person_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc) AS row_id , f_cdnm('ProvideRcvType' , biz01_provide_rcv_type , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_provide_rcv_type_nm , f_cdnm('SettleType' , biz01_settle_type , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_settle_type_nm , f_cdnm('ProvidePurCode' , biz01_provide_pur_cd , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_provide_pur_nm , f_cdnm('ProvideContentCode' , biz01_provide_content_cd , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_provide_content_nm , f_cdnm('TaxType' , biz01_tax_type , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_tax_type_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz01_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '마감' ELSE '' END AS biz01_close_nm , CASE WHEN biz01_settle_type = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(person_id) ELSE biz01_person_nm END AS biz01_reg_emp_nm , f_get_empTrans(person_id, biz01_provide_date, 'org_code_nm') AS biz01_org_nm , BIZ.* FROM ( /*--- 이익제공 ---*/ SELECT BIZ_BASE.* , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz02_emp_count,0) = 0 THEN f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_reg_emp_id) ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id AND biz02_emp_id = biz01_reg_emp_id) = 0 THEN biz02_emp_nm ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_reg_emp_id) END) ||(CASE WHEN biz02_emp_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '||biz02_emp_count-1 END) END AS biz01_person_nm , CONCAT(biz02_target_company_nm,' ' ,biz02_target_emp_nm ,'('||biz02_target_org_nm||')') AS biz01_target_nm , biz02_target_company_nm AS biz01_target_company_nm , biz02_target_emp_nm AS biz01_target_emp_nm , biz02_target_org_nm AS biz01_target_org_nm FROM BIZ_BASE LEFT OUTER JOIN biz02_person a ON a.biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id WHERE biz01_provide_rcv_type = '1' AND COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') != 'true' AND biz01_average_price > (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,2,1) = '0' THEN COALESCE(biz90_sale_rule_limit1, 0) /* 일반 */ ELSE COALESCE(biz90_sale_rule_limit2, 0) END) /* 경조 */ /*--- 이익제공(거래상대방 미등록) ---*/ UNION ALL SELECT BIZ_BASE.* , f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_reg_emp_id) AS biz01_person_nm , '*미등록*' AS biz01_target_nm , '*미등록*' AS biz01_target_company_nm , null AS biz01_target_emp_nm , null AS biz01_target_org_nm FROM BIZ_BASE WHERE biz01_provide_rcv_type = '1' AND biz01_average_price > (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,2,1) = '0' THEN COALESCE(biz90_sale_rule_limit1, 0) /* 일반 */ ELSE
